Policies and Initiatives.title: Union Budget 2026: Seven new rail corridors announced
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget 2026 has announced seven new rail corridors, dubbed "growth connectors", spanning 4,000 km. These corridors will connect major cities, including Mumbai-Pune, Pune-Hyderabad, and Delhi-Varanasi, among others. The infrastructure project is estimated to cost ₹16 lakh crore.

Policies and Initiatives.title: ‘Union Budget focusses on long-term reforms & capital expenditure’
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget prioritizes long-term reforms and capital expenditure, indicating a focus on sustainable growth. This approach is expected to have a positive impact on the economy, driving development and investment. The budget's emphasis on capital expenditure suggests a commitment to infrastructure development and other key sectors.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Budget 2026: Experts flag risks of proposed restructuring of REC, PFC; raises privatisation fears
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Experts are concerned about the proposed restructuring of REC and PFC in the Union Budget 2026, fearing it could lead to weakened public institutions and privatization. Despite the entities' strong profits, critics question the necessity of the move, citing potential private sector influence. Power engineers have vowed to oppose any attempts at covert privatization.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Union Budget reflects vision of developed India, says Yogi; Akhilesh terms it ‘disappointing’, Mayawati questions promises
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Union Budget has received mixed reactions from politicians, with Yogi praising it as a vision for a developed India. Akhilesh Yadav expressed disappointment with the budget, while Mayawati questioned the promises made in it. The budget has sparked differing opinions among Indian leaders, reflecting varying expectations and priorities.

Policies and Initiatives.title: As Delhi-Meerut RRTS wraps up, NCRTC sees Rs 700-crore dip in Union Budget. Here’s why
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) has seen a Rs 700-crore reduction in the Union Budget. This decrease comes as the Delhi-Meerut Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS) project nears completion. The reduced allocation is likely due to the project's progressing stage, requiring less funding.

Policies and Initiatives.title: CM Rekha hails Budget, terms it people-centric
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Delhi's Chief Minister welcomed the Union Budget 2026-27, praising its focus on economic growth and citizen well-being. The budget prioritizes key groups including farmers, youth, women, and infrastructure development, such as the Delhi-Varanasi high-speed rail. Former CM Kejriwal criticized the budget for not addressing loan waivers, unemployment, and inflation.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Policy Leaders and Innovators deliberate future of Responsible Health AI as Federated Intelligence Hackathon Concludes at IIT Kanpur
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Policy leaders and innovators gathered at IIT Kanpur to discuss the future of responsible health AI. The event coincided with the conclusion of the Federated Intelligence Hackathon, which focused on health AI. The deliberations aimed to shape the development of health AI in a responsible and innovative manner.

Policies and Initiatives.title: UP govt to host AI-led innovation, skills conference in Lucknow
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government will host an AI-led innovation and skills conference in Lucknow, bringing together global technology majors. Companies such as Microsoft, Google, TCS, and Intel are set to participate in the event. The conference aims to promote AI-led innovation and skills development in the region.
